name: agility-bridge
description: Work with Digital.ai Agility from Claude Code: your backlog, sprints and work items through the agility-bridge MCP server, read-only by default.

agility_url.title: Agility instance address
agility_url.description: The address you open Agility at, up to the instance name, for example https://www7.v1host.com/YourInstance (https only)

agility_token.title: Agility access token
agility_token.description: Create one on the Agility Applications page (your avatar, then Applications). It acts as you and does not expire: revoke it there when you stop using it
